name: spi-regulatory-scanner
description: Repository validation for the SPI regulatory and IP radar

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix functions test
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-spi-scanner --config firebase.test.json "node --test test/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.eval:ai: npm --prefix functions run build && node --test test/ai-evaluation.test.cjs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run eval:ai && npm run check:docs && npm run test:rules
